head: Disney Plus TikTok videos come to the Verts feed in December
dek: TikTok creator videos about Disney's films and shows will start showing in Verts, the swipeable vertical feed in the US Disney+ mobile app, in December, Pocket-lint reports. Creators join by invitation, and the videos stay on TikTok too.
details: Disney and TikTok announced the deal in August, and invitations to creators who already make Disney videos go out on a rolling basis from November. Under Disney's guidelines a video can run up to 10 minutes with at most 5 minutes of Disney footage and must add the creator's own commentary or analysis; AI-generated characters, voice cloning and big spoilers aren't allowed, and Disney picks what's published. Verts launched in the US Disney+ app on 12 March and isn't on TV apps.
where: US, Disney+ app on phones, from December
means: If you use Disney+ on your phone in the US, the Verts feed will mix fan videos from TikTok with clips from Disney's own films and shows.
todo: Nothing to do; look for the Verts icon in the Disney+ app's navigation bar in December.
